text: Mind the grating, it is live on the left side. ...You are the auditor. Kowal. I keep the lights on.
You want the short version? She is a forty-year-old tokamak running at {round(cond('reactor'))} percent on a containment coil I rewound by hand. She needs parts. I have asked for parts. I get forms.

choices.text: What happens if the reactor fails?
The coil wants re-shimming, not rewinding. Look at the harmonic.

text: Marlow. The stores have parts on the shelf and scrap for the fabricator. Every requisition comes back 'pending countersignature'. Meanwhile half my power goes to a laboratory.
Go and look at the power queue if you do not believe me. The lab sits second. Ahead of water. Ahead of food. The Administrator signed it.

fails.text: The RTG keeps the scrubbers turning at two-thirds. Everything else stops. No water plant, no grow lamps, no heat. Call it four days before people start dying, and they would be long days.

shim.text: ...Huh. You have had your hands inside one of these. Nobody from the Combine has had their hands inside anything. All right. You, I will talk to.

variants.text: Hear that? That is what she is supposed to sound like. What do you need?
She is dying on me. Unless you have parts in your pockets, I am busy.
I need {wants_count()} more {item_name(wants())} and I cannot find any. What?

choices.text: The Administrator has opened the stores to you.
I have moved the lab down the power queue.
What do you make of Dr. Suvari's work?
The fuel hopper. How long have we got?

give_parts.text: Regulator boards. Real ones. ...I will not ask where. She will have these in her by the end of the shift.

status.text: Integrity {round(cond('reactor'))} percent. Output {round(power_supply())} kilowatts against {round(power_demand())} asked for. {'We are browning out; the queue decides who goes dark.' if brownout() else 'For once there is enough to go round.'}

stores_open.text: She did? Over Marlow's countersignature? ...Tell her thank you. No. I will tell her myself. Later. After I have stripped that shelf.

lab_done.text: The fabricator is drawing again. First time in a month. Suvari will want your head. I would buy you a drink if Marlow had not sold all of it.

text: She is listening to the ice. Thirty-four kilowatts to listen to ice. I have told the Administrator what I think and I was told it was not my department.
Something down there has got into her, and into Tuck. I fix machines. I do not know how to fix that.

fuel.text: {round(container_count('reactor_hopper', 'fuel_cell'))} in the hopper, {round(container_count('stores_fuel', 'fuel_cell'))} in the fuel locker, and each one is about a day. I count them every morning. Lately the count has been coming up short, and I do not make arithmetic mistakes.

variants.text: Listening to her. You learn more that way than from the board.
